subject: english
stem: Which sentence correctly contrasts then and now?
options: There were one shop before, but there is four now.
There is one shop before, but there were four now.
There was shops before, but there are one now.
There was one shop before, but there are four shops now.

optionRationales.reason: There were one shop before, but there is four now.：兩邊數都不一致。
There is one shop before, but there were four now.：兩邊時態顛倒。
There was shops before, but there are one now.：兩邊名詞數與 be 不合。
There was one shop before, but there are four shops now.：前項過去單數，後項現在複數，各自一致。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「依存在物核心名詞的數與事件時間，選擇 there is/are 或 there was/were，並在多項清單中保持資訊精確。」可推出 There was one shop before, but there are four shops now.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 There was one shop before, but there are four shops now. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
